The key is ExamineWindow, so the thing that is locked is النافذة, which is feminine. The sibling bare-status line in the same memory gets this right ((sigh) Empty -> فارغة, agreeing with الزجاجة).

Uncertain, flagging rather than asserting. Tiel is the one moving through this scene (Locked. / Anybody home? / entering the dwelling), so 'There you are' is most likely him finding the dwelling's occupant - the woman he later addresses as انظري إليّ.
